note: Ground truth for the labelled set. Bench cases carry their truth in a header comment (truth/class/circuit/line); the zoo is listed here. A leak's span is the body of the named circuit (or constructor) containing the leak line. Each leaky file has exactly one planted privacy leak.

zoo/ballot-leaky.compact.why: hash(choice) with choice asserted below 4: four hashes read every vote

zoo/board-leaky.compact.why: every post stores the same hash(memberKey) as author: one identified post unmasks all of a member's posts

zoo/club-leaky.compact.why: a claim looks the caller leaf up in the member set; the lookup key is in the public transcript, so every claim names its member

zoo/deposit-leaky.compact.why: each bidder locks exactly the sealed bid in unshielded tokens; unshielded amounts are public, so the deposit reveals the bid the commitment hides

zoo/faucet-leaky.compact.why: the shielded coin nonce is evolved from a public ledger value, color and amount are public, so the recipient wallet can be confirmed one hash per candidate key

zoo/keyring-leaky.compact.why: the public account id is also the private scalar of the encryption key stored next to it

zoo/payband-leaky.compact.why: hash(public employee id, salary): only the salary is unknown and it falls to brute force

zoo/raffle-leaky.compact.why: the constructor seals the winning number (one of 10,000) with a plain hash: 10,000 hashes read it from the initial state

zoo/reserve-leaky.compact.why: which set is written reveals whether each hidden bid meets the reserve

zoo/vault-leaky.compact.why: the owner's secret key is written to the ledger
